Room.title: Bank El-Hazz Room
Room.description: Synchronized multiplayer room and game state for Bank El-Hazz (up to 10 players).

hostUid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the room host.

playerUids.description: Bounded list of up to 10 authenticated player UIDs in the room.

settings.description: Host-configurable room rules (startingMoney, goReward, freeParkingJackpot, maxPlayers, auctionEnabled, turnTimeLimitSec, gameDurationMin, jailBail, doubleGoBonus).

gameState.description: Synchronized board, player balances, properties, turn state, active card, live auction, trade offer, bounded event log, matchStartedAt, and turnStartedAt.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest state update.

ChatMessage.title: Room Chat Message
ChatMessage.description: Real-time chat message sent by a player inside an online Bank El-Hazz room.

senderUid.description: Authenticated UID of the message sender.

senderColor.description: Hex color associated with the sender's piece.

participantUids.description: Bounded snapshot of up to 10 player UIDs authorized to read this room message.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was posted.

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Primary multiplayer room document storing lobby members, settings, and live Bank El-Hazz board state.

/rooms/{roomId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Scalable subcollection for live in-room chat messages.
